name: OpenResearch
description: Turn your coding agents into research agents
one_liner: Turns an AI coding assistant into a research assistant that can read piles of scientific papers, organize them, form hypotheses, and draft findings for you.
buyer: A PhD researcher or R&D team at a biotech or pharma company drowning in papers who wants an AI to pre-digest the literature before a human reads it.
business_use_cases: A research lab auto-summarizes and cross-references the week's new papers in its field every Monday morning.
A VC or industry analyst tracks a fast-moving technical space (batteries, LLMs) and produces weekly technical briefs for clients.
A freelance science writer speed-drafts literature-review sections for academic or industry clients.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a weekly literature-digest newsletter for a specific fast-moving research niche
Offer custom research-agent setup consulting for labs and R&D teams

steal_this: Pick one fast-moving research field, run it this weekend, and sell the resulting weekly digest as a paid newsletter.
